faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about learning copywriting with CopyCoach AI.
faqQ1: Is CopyCoach AI a writing generator?
faqA1: No. CopyCoach AI is designed to teach you copywriting skills through feedback, explanations, and practice.
faqA2: Yes. The platform is designed for complete beginners and also helps experienced writers improve.
faqQ3: What type of copy can I practice?
faqA3: You can practice emails, advertisements, landing pages, headlines, sales copy, and more.
faqQ4: How does the AI feedback work?
faqA4: The AI analyzes your copy based on clarity, persuasion, structure, emotional impact, and proven copywriting principles.
faqQ5: Will the AI write my copy for me?
faqA5: The AI focuses on coaching you. It provides guidance and suggestions so you develop your own writing ability.

appFaqQ1: How does the CopyCoach AI scoring algorithm evaluate copy?
appFaqA1: CopyCoach AI analyzes your text against core copywriting frameworks (AIDA, PAS, BAB, FAB, 4Ps). It checks emotional trigger intensity, hook strength, clarity, readability, target audience resonance, and call-to-action urgency to assign a score from 0 to 100.
appFaqQ2: How do I install the mobile app on Android or iOS?
appFaqA2: For Android, click the 'Google Play Store' badge or direct 'Download APK' button below. For iOS, scan the QR code with your iPhone camera to open the web app in Safari, then tap Share -> 'Add to Home Screen' for native full-screen app access.
appFaqQ3: Can I practice with custom client briefs and specific brand tones?
appFaqA3: Yes! In the dashboard, you can create custom Project Folders, define target personas, select brand tones (Bold & Punchy, Empathetic & Warm, Authoritative, Casual), and upload custom client briefs to simulate real client scenarios.
appFaqQ4: What support is included in free vs pro accounts?
appFaqA4: All accounts receive 24/7 AI-assisted support. Pro and Studio members receive priority human engineering review with escalated ticket response times.
appPriorityDesc: Our dedicated engineering support team monitors incoming submissions directly. You can also reach out via email or check platform updates anytime.
